item.title: I oppose illegal immigration, but my first allegiance is to the United States Constitution.
item.description: "Too many of you are chasing your tails. This is simple. It is irrelevant if an immigrant came here illegally. Once they are here, they have rights under the Constitution. It is irrelevant if a protestor is paid. They are protected under the Constitution. If you want this to change, work with your federal lawmakers to introduce an amendment to the Constitution removing illegals and paid protestors from its protections. In the meantime, the Constitution is the law of the land. All other laws ebb
